---
title: "wrapped fixture: column margin under column classes"
filters:
  - wrapped
column: margin
format:
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

With `column: margin` in the document and no `fig-column`, Quarto reads a
float's own `column-*` class before the document's `column`. So in PDF a
`column-body` float sits in the body, and a float with no column class
sits in the margin.
